annotations.title: Read one startup pitch with score, roast and decisions

description: Read one startup pitch by id and choose what comes back with "sections": "pitch" (the full public pitch, the same object as pitchspark_get_pitch_v1), "score" (score and roast, as pitchspark_get_score_v1), "decisions" (anonymised decision aggregates by signed-in users, as pitchspark_get_decision_summary_v1). Default: all three. Use when: an investor wants the whole picture of one shortlisted pitch in one call. Prefer the single-purpose tools when you only need one part. Link the pitch with its spark_card_url; the investor sign-up link a reply may carry in _meta (it returns a new investor to this pitch after sign-up) is not a pitch link. Do not use for: searching (pitchspark_search_pitches_v3), founder contact details, financials, decks or data rooms (never returned), investment advice. Anonymous callers can use it under the daily allowance; dimension scores and analyses need an API key, and the decisions section an investor API key. Decision data from signed-in PitchSpark users needs a PitchSpark API key from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation): without one every decision block is available false with reason key_required. It is anonymised: counts of distinct people only, as bands ("5-9", "10-24", "25-49", "50+"), never who; shares and rates to the nearest 0.05; the pitch's founders, team and PitchSpark staff are never counted; guest and anonymous viewers are never counted; every block is withheld (reason below_min_k) when fewer than 5 distinct people are behind it, and a split (positive vs pass, rating bands) is withheld when any part of it would be under 5; no investor comment text is ever returned. Who is counted: ratings, reading time, sections and score views count ANY signed-in non-owner user (the writers check no account type), and likes, passes and pass reasons count signed-in users who swiped or gave pass feedback (also not restricted to investor accounts); only the caller of this tool must hold an investor key. Some fields are withheld pending a review (reason hidden_pending_review, or absent from a list): the team-related pass reasons and the pass rate (the likes-vs-passes thumbs block, the search card signal, investors_considered and the card-dwell figures). Treat a withheld field as no signal. An id that does not exist, a pitch that is not public and a pitch whose founders opted out of AI agents all answer NOT_FOUND. Each pitch this tool returns counts 1 against the daily pitch allowance (the one allowance every pitch tool shares), or 0 when the same API key (without a key, the same connection) already got that pitch today. Calls are logged, and each pitch returned is counted as a view.

id.description: The pitch id from a search result ("id").

name: pitchspark_get_pitch_v2

decisions.description: Anonymised decision aggregates by signed-in PitchSpark users (not only investors); readable with investor API keys only (every block reason key_required otherwise). Counts are bands ("5-9", "10-24", "25-49", "50+"); every block is withheld below min_k distinct signed-in users (the counts cover any signed-in non-owner user, not only investor accounts).

investors_considered.description: Distinct signed-in PitchSpark users (not only investors) behind the figures, as a band; null below min_k, and null while the pass rate is hidden pending review.

pass_reasons.description: Top pass reasons, shares over the listed (visible) reasons only. The team-related reasons are withheld pending review and never appear.

available.description: false when the block is withheld: fewer than min_k distinct signed-in users (below_min_k), no source data (no_data), a read failed (unavailable), or the field is hidden pending a review (hidden_pending_review).

pass_themes.description: Why-we-passed themes. The team theme is withheld pending review and never appears.

thumbs.description: Likes vs passes (positive / pass / superlike bands, pass_rate). Withheld with reason hidden_pending_review while the pass rate is hidden pending review: treat that as no signal.

time_spent.description: Median time on the pitch and per-section reading. The card-dwell figures (median_card_dwell_seconds, investors_with_card_dwell) are null while the pass rate is hidden pending review.

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

pitch.description: pitchspark_get_pitch_v1's pitch object (same keys), present when sections includes "pitch".
